obs.note: one window = the last window_steps reports, oldest first, each row in the order of names; x_norm = fn(x / pre) / post with fn lin (identity) or slog1p (sign(x) ln(1 + |x|)); when range_valid is 0 the features z, range_m, rep_sigma_m, lq_degraded and range_class_long are 0

act.note: probability that B's reports are faulty at the window's last step = 1 / (1 + exp(-logit)); alarm when logit > threshold (thresholds below)

layer_note: w[out][in][tap]; valid convolution, tap j reads step t + j * dilation; a residual layer adds its input at the same (latest) steps to its ReLU output; the last layer gives the logit

thresholds.note: set on validation fault-free blocks; a false alarm is a 60 s bin with an alarm
